stories.headline: Margaret Hamilton, whose software helped land Apollo 11 on the Moon, dies at 90

stories.why_it_matters: Hamilton's software innovations laid foundational principles for reliable spaceflight systems and advanced software engineering practices still used in aerospace.
stories.perspective_one: Her supporters emphasize her technical genius and role in elevating women’s contributions to STEM fields historically overlooked.
stories.perspective_two: Some critics argue that recognition of women in early computing has been gradual and insufficient despite such landmark achievements.
